summary.zh: 在输入框上方与 DSH Go 原生面板查看 OpenCode Go、DeepSeek、OpenAI Codex 和小米 MiMo 的余额与额度；Codex 支持多账户查看与切换，也可添加自定义余额渠道。
summary.en: Balances and quotas for OpenCode Go, DeepSeek, OpenAI Codex and Xiaomi MiMo in the composer strip and native DSH Go panels, with multi-account Codex view/switch and custom balance channels.
